picks.editorial_note: Fermilab's selection under DOE's Genesis Mission puts AI at the center of national particle-accelerator infrastructure, signaling how federal AI investment is expanding beyond data centers into fundamental physics facilities.
picks.title: DOE selects Fermilab-led AI initiative to advance particle accelerator performance

picks.editorial_note: A £5M UK government-backed, Google-led trial spanning Cambridge and Imperial is the world's first real-world test of AI-guided flight path changes to cut aviation's climate impact — a rare case of AI research translating directly into environmental policy action.
picks.title: World’s first trial to test if flightpath changes could cut aviation’s climate impact

picks.editorial_note: Purdue's role in over $42 million of NSF-funded national data infrastructure grants underscores the scale of investment now flowing into the cyberinfrastructure that underpins AI-driven research nationwide.
picks.title: Purdue enables AI- and data- cyberinfras...
picks.university: Purdue Rosen Center for Advanced Computing

picks.editorial_note: The $9M NSF-backed iDLab, unifying browser-based access to national HPC centers, directly advances the NAIRR pilot's goal of democratizing AI compute access across academia.
picks.title: NCSA Partners with UCLA for iDLab

picks.editorial_note: Johns Hopkins' partnership with Toyota Research Institute pairs AI with high-throughput automated experiments to accelerate battery materials discovery — a concrete example of AI-driven science with commercial energy-storage stakes.
picks.title: Johns Hopkins team partners with Toyota Research Institute to accelerate new battery discovery

picks.editorial_note: MIT's discovery of 'attribution decay' — that generative AI outputs often can't be traced to any specific training example — has significant implications for copyright, provenance, and AI accountability debates.
picks.title: When AI art has no author: MIT study finds generated images often can't be traced to any training data

picks.editorial_note: Imperial College's five-year center with Smith+Nephew aims to translate academic AI and computer-vision research directly into surgical robotics products, bridging lab research and clinical application.
picks.title: New centre from Imperial and Smith+Nephew will accelerate innovation in surgical robotics

picks.editorial_note: Tohoku University and Western Digital's new joint lab targets the data-storage bottlenecks constraining AI scaling, a strategically important but often overlooked layer of AI infrastructure.
picks.title: Tohoku University Launches AI Data Infrastructure Lab with Western Digital Corporation

picks.editorial_note: MIT Lincoln Laboratory's ARCADE agentic assistant moving into U.S. Air Force Collaborative Combat Aircraft operations marks a concrete step of AI research into operational military policy and defense decision-making.
picks.title: Human–AI mission debrief enters the Air Force through ARCADE

picks.editorial_note: A Kent State researcher's DOE Genesis Mission award to mine 50 years of water-quality data for critical minerals shows federal AI funding being directed at national supply-chain and resource-security priorities.
picks.title: Kent State Researcher Selected for US Department of Energy Genesis Mission Award to Mine Decades of River Data for Critical Minerals; Kent State Today; July 29, 2026
